name: Dusklight

original.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

assets.needs: Twilight Princess GameCube USA disc image (GZ2E01), ISO/CISO/RVZ-style image, picked in the pre-launch UI.
assets.location: Read in place through a SAF document URI (content://...) stored in config.json backend.isoPath.
assets.notes: backend.isoVerification = 1 (Success) means the picked image passed the hash check.

settings.in_app_menu: Pre-launch screen > Settings, or in game via the Dusklight menu (bindable action openDusklightMenu). A Graphics Tuner carousel covers resolution, shadows, bloom, depth of field and texture packs.
settings.summary: Internal resolution (Auto or 1-12x), shadow resolution 1-8x, frame interpolation (Off/Capped/Unlimited) with framerate cap 30-540, bloom and depth of field (Off/Classic/Dusklight), letterboxing, menu scaling, many QoL toggles (fast climbing, instant saves, bigger wallets...), gyro aim, touch controls. Presets include 'Dusklight'.

controls: SDL gamepad; the Thor pad is saved as 'Odin Controller_2020_0111.controller' mapping. Per-port action bindings (call Midna, first-person, map, turbo) in config.json actionBindings.*_port0..3. Gyro aim option. Optional on-screen touch controls (game.enableTouchControls).
display: Official build is single-screen (no secondary-display code in the APK). A dual-screen fork exists (github.com/igawa6/dusklight; also Darkaxt/Dusklight-Android-Dual-Screen-Bleeding-Edge).
saves: Memory card GCI folder: /data/data/dev.twilitrealm.dusk/files/USA/Card A/01-GZ2E-gczelda2.gci (backend.cardFileType 1 = GCI Folder). Root-only path; back up with su.
notes: v2.0.3 released 2026-09-30. Ships bundled mods (cosmetics, luau_runtime, randomizer .dusk files) and a Dawn pipeline cache. Launch args can be passed with am start --es borealis_args "--backend vulkan". Logs in files/logs; a run that stops with 'Surface present failed' there is a renderer failure (seen with v2.0.2).
verified: On device: dumpsys, config.json (read in full), files listing, save folder, log. Source: TwilitRealm/dusklight at tag v2.0.2 (settings.h/.cpp, ui/settings.cpp, ui/graphics_tuner.cpp, ui/preset.cpp, config.cpp, platforms/android/README.md). LICENSE.md is CC0 1.0.
